# audit-assignment-lexer

Behavior contract:
parseFields(line) parses a single physical line of space/tab-separated key=value fields. Keys match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* and cannot repeat. Unquoted values run until space, tab, '#', or end; they may be empty and contain '=' but cannot contain quotes or backslashes. A value starting with double quote continues to its matching quote, allows '#' and spaces, and supports only escaped quote and escaped backslash. After a closing quote only separator, '#', or end is valid. '#' outside quotes starts a comment. Reject malformed keys, missing '=', duplicate keys, unknown escapes, unclosed quotes, and any CR/LF with SyntaxError. Return an object of own string properties, safely including '__proto__'.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
